I saved this to EngramDB as a project decision, so other sessions and collaborators will see it too. From now on, all new or changed public API routes go under `/v2`, and `/v1` gets no new endpoints and no behavior changes.

I searched the repo and the existing memories, and nothing conflicts with the decision. The only `/v1` paths in the code point to other services, so the rule doesn't apply to them. I wrote that exception into the memory so nobody "fixes" them by mistake:
- `src/billing/invoices.py:8`: the internal ledger's `/v1/postings` URL
- `tests/test_payments.py:4`: the payments sandbox's `/v1/charges` URL
